name: SK_ID_PREV
details: ID of previous credit in Home Credit related to loan in our sample. (One loan in our sample can have 0,1,2 or more previous loans in Home Credit)

name: SK_ID_CURR
details: ID of loan in our sample

name: MONTHS_BALANCE
details: Month of balance relative to application date (-1 means the information to the freshest monthly snapshot, 0 means the information at application - often it will be the same as -1 as many banks are not updating the information to Credit Bureau regularly ) [Metadata note: time only relative to the application.]

name: CNT_INSTALMENT
details: Term of previous credit (can change over time)

name: CNT_INSTALMENT_FUTURE
details: Installments left to pay on the previous credit

name: SK_DPD
details: DPD (days past due) during the month of previous credit

name: SK_DPD_DEF
details: DPD during the month with tolerance (debts with low loan amounts are ignored) of the previous credit
